keyFindings.description: window.request's answer goroutine calls confirmFlushed, whose conn.FlushTimeout runs for the request's whole remaining timeout when nats.go already moved the connection to RECONNECTING (nats.go v1.50 clears pending flushes only at the CONNECTED->RECONNECTING transition, nats.go:3329-3341, and FlushTimeout queues a new PING that no server answers). So a Request whose connection drops before its flush starts answers ErrUnavailable only after its timeout, not once the loss is seen, which its doc and TestARequestWhoseConnectionIsLostAnswersUnavailable assert; the test went red in envoy-go at bcf50ed5. Probe (go test -overlay): confirmFlushed on a connection nats.go saw drop returned 'nats: timeout after 3.001s'. Fix: do not wait on the flush past a connection change (watch ConnectionChanged while flushing, or skip the flush when the window's connection is no longer current).
